title: Chapter 2935 - 171: Inscribing the Life Formation
content:
Chapter 2935: Chapter 171: Inscribing the Life Formation

Third-grade Lvyou Mountain Realm, Gao Tu’s main hall, Chieftain’s hall.

Mo Hua sat in a high position, his face handsome as white jade, eyes suffused with a faint golden hue, indifferent, looking beyond the mundane world.

The heavily injured Gao Tu General, Gao Du, was pressed down by Lugu, kneeling on the ground.

Gao Du, in the late Golden Core stage, as a general, naturally possessed the pride of a strong fighter, now being subdued, kneeling before a mere "Divine Way Puppet" at the Foundation Establishment Realm, harbored natural resentment in his heart.

Not to mention, this "Divine Way Puppet" looked only twenty, absurdly "young".

Gao Du suddenly raised his head, about to utter harsh words, when he suddenly felt a powerful demon aura, his expression changed, he turned to look, and saw beside him, unknown when it appeared, stood a Tiger Demon with a body of white jade mixed with black patterns.

This Tiger Demon was massive, a domineering "king" character on its head, its presence overpowering, its demon aura mighty, yet it carried an air of holiness, its eyes like thunder, awe-inspiring, making one tremble with fear at its sight.

A third-grade King Demon...

Moreover, it had no chains, no shackles, no Holy Patterns, not a trace of "constraint" means.

It roamed the hall casually like this.

Previously, Gao Du had only seen this tiger from afar, thinking it a "fake," but now, close up, feeling the pressure of the third-grade Golden Core Demon Beast, and that divine, majestic aura, he realized it was truly different...

This King Demon was no mere showpiece.

Its bloodline aura was astonishingly powerful.

The big tiger didn’t seem to like this "toad" like Gao Du either, extended its furry big paw, disdainfully patted Gao Du’s head.

Its big paw appeared furry, but had copper skin and iron bones, as hard as a big hammer.

Gao Du’s skull buzzed from the pat, but he could only keep his head low, not daring to make a sound.

At this moment, a cold yet authoritative voice came from above:

"Return."

Hearing Mo Hua call it, the big tiger then left Gao Du, paced its way up to the high hall, lying beside Mo Hua, its head nudging under Mo Hua’s hand.

Mo Hua extended his hand, gently stroking the big tiger’s head.

Seeing this scene, Gao Du’s heart suddenly contracted.

In front of this Foundation Establishment "Divine Blessing," this wild and terrifying third-grade Tiger Demon, was as tame as a kitten.

Only then did Gao Du realize, his previous assumptions might have been gravely mistaken...

He pressed his head even lower, not daring to look up at Mo Hua.

At this moment, Mo Hua spoke.

While stroking the big tiger, he said indifferently to Gao Du:

"Submit to the Divine Lord, and serve me, and I will spare your life."

Gao Du’s eyes widened, his mind in turmoil.

But he didn’t respond whether he was willing or not, instead asked the most insistent matter in his heart:

"I just want to know, that creature that fought me, the one that eats Golden Cores... what exactly is it..."

Mo Hua said, "It is the Divine Lord’s... Undying General."

"Undying General..."

Gao Du’s heart trembled, the brutal scenes of that day surfacing in his mind. That creature, impossible to kill, even when nearly dead, just eats a Golden Core and can "come back to life" again, making him shudder just thinking about it to this day.

"How could this be..." Gao Du murmured in disbelief.

"It is the Divine Lord’s ’creation,’ existing between life and death, with an undying body, waging wars for the Divine Lord." Mo Hua said indifferently.

Gao Du’s expression shook, seeming as though he wanted to ask something more, but upon looking up, dared not speak again.

He could feel this "Divine Blessing Lord’s" gaze was growing colder, seemingly losing patience with him, should he continue questioning, it might incite the Divine Blessing Lord’s anger.

Sure enough, Mo Hua simply said coldly:

"I ask you once more, will you submit?"

Gao Du lowered his head, hesitated for a moment, and gritted his teeth:

"Gao Du... as a General of Gao Tu Tribe, loyal to the tribe, loyal to the Great Chief, dare not betray..."

"No matter," Mo Hua said: "You are now the Great Chief of Gao Tu."

As the Great Chief, there is naturally no need to be loyal to any other Great Chief.

Just be loyal to yourself.

Gao Du was stunned, a bit incredulous, "I... Great Chief, but... my... name is not right..."

Mo Hua said indifferently: "The greatest ’name’ in the Great Wilderness, is the Divine Lord’s ’name.’ By the Divine Lord’s name, I declare you Great Chief, you are the Great Chief."

Gao Du suddenly realized, and immediately knocked his head three times for Mo Hua:

"Gao Du, Great Chief of Gao Tu Tribe, willing to lie low for the Divine Blessing Lord, and strive with all my heart, until my death."

Mo Hua nodded slightly, "The Divine Lord will bless you. From now on, as the Great Chief of Gao Tu, remember the teachings of the Divine Lord, besides that, all affairs within Gao Tu Tribe, you decide alone."

Gao Du kowtowed, "Yes, thank the Divine Blessing Lord for the grace. From now on, the Gao Tu Tribe will certainly uphold the name of the Divine Lord, take the lead of the Divine Blessing Lord."

Mo Hua nodded, "Leave now."

Lugu released Gao Du.

Gao Du gave Lugu a somewhat resentful glance, then looked reverently at Mo Hua, and at the fierce and domineering Holy Beast Fierce Tiger that was being petted by Mo Hua’s side, as gentle as a kitten.

Gao Du bent his back, bowed, and withdrew.

After Gao Du left, only Mo Hua and Lugu were left in the hall, along with a speechless big tiger.

The hall was very quiet for a moment.

Lugu did not leave, instead, looked at Mo Hua with a complex gaze, hesitated for a long time, and then slowly said:

"Divine Blessing Lord... my brother, he..."

Mo Hua’s voice was calm, showing no emotion: "He has received the Divine Lord’s blessing, and is on his ’destined’ path."
